The evaluation's unchanged-dimensions note for this pair: nothing in either draft violates a checkable NORMATIVE rule (particle attachment, 되/돼, spacing).

AFTER collapses BEFORE's self-narrating scaffold ("뚜스거리는 사건이 아니라 관점이다. 그래서 ...")  into "여기서 뚜스거리는 사건이 아니라 관점 자체다.", removing the nq-translationese-connective-scaffolding / nq-connective-adverb-overuse pattern the BEFORE draft was FAIL on.

AFTER doubles the attribution verbs relative to BEFORE (3 → 6: 짚는다 ×2, 지적하며, 우려한다, 못 박는다, 본다), applying reg-news-attribution-placement's nested paraphrase-then-verb shape to a written View rather than a person who spoke; the evaluation calls this "not wrong" but flags it (see notes / F3).
Both BEFORE and AFTER are pitched at the same general reader; nothing in the audience-facing vocabulary or framing changed between drafts.
Both drafts keep 스프레드시트 / AI / CRM in the same forms across BEFORE and AFTER.

No human has expressed a preference on this draft or any of the fifteen drafts read by the SUE-604 evaluation; editorial/voice.md records the voice, not a verdict on this text. Silence is not acceptance.

notes: Transcribed from evals/dogfood/2026-09-05-sue604-recalibration/sue604-evaluation.md §2.1. native_fluency moved FAIL→PASS on this pair (the real fluency gain: de-narrating the argument, de-nominalising). genre_fit stays PASS but the evaluation separately raises F3 (routes to 'register'): reg-news-attribution-placement's document-attribution pattern ("필자는 ... 지적하며 ... 짚는다") is corroborated only for a person who spoke on one day's event, and applying it to a View is a genre-scope question for future calibration, not a per-draft genre_fit FAIL on this record. Comparative dimensions (thesis-worth etc.) abstain: the source evaluation did not assess this draft against a GOOD reference on those axes. comparison.mode is "abstain" and outcome is ABSTAIN where no language dimension failed: the evaluation this record transcribes assessed only the seven absolute language_quality dimensions and made no comparative judgement against a reference on any of the five comparative axes. Recording mode "pairwise" would assert a comparison that never happened, and a comparative PASS would claim the draft was measured against the reference and held up. The references are still named because they were the genre-matched pool available and a later comparative pass should use them.
